summary: This dataset contains 3000 OCT images of porcine kidneys from three tissue types: cortex, medulla, and calyx, with 1000 images per tissue per kidney. The images were obtained using a forward-view optical coherence tomography (OCT) endoscopic system for percutaneous nephrostomy (PCN) guidance. A deep-learning-based computer-aided diagnosis platform was developed to automatically classify the OCT images by renal tissue types, achieving an average classification accuracy of 82.6% with ResNet50-based convolutional neural networks (CNN).
